Name: Pet Adopter
Author: CodeKokeshi
Description:
[quote][b]Pet Adopter[/b] lets you adopt pets instantly through a clean [b]StardewUI [/b]menu, with no shop purchase required.

Press [b]Left Shift + V[/b] to open the menu, browse all available pet breeds with left/right arrows, preview each pet’s real in-game sprite, and adopt in one click.[/quote]

After you press Adopt, the game opens the vanilla naming menu, then spawns the pet in/around the farmhouse area with a randomized offset to reduce stacking when adopting multiple pets quickly.

[b]By default, the mod follows vanilla-style bowl behavior:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adoption is allowed even if no empty bowl is available.
[*]Pets without their own bowl can still exist (with vanilla-style downsides).
[/list]
[b]You can optionally enforce bowl limits in GMCM:[/b]
[list]
[*]Require Free Bowl (default: Off)
[*]When enabled, adoption is blocked unless an empty pet bowl is available.
[/list]
Supports vanilla and modded pet types/breeds from Data/Pets, and uses StardewUI for a lightweight, polished interface.

[b][center][quote]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UJzghHO.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6CpzWci.png[/img][/quote][/center][/b]

[b]Features[/b]:
[list]
[*]Hotkey menu (default: LShift + V, configurable in GMCM)
[*]Browse pet variants with arrow controls
[*]Real sprite preview (not icon-only)
[*]1-indexed labels (Dog 1, Cat 2, etc.)
[*]Vanilla-style naming prompt after adoption
[*]Optional bowl-limit enforcement via GMCM
[*]Randomized spawn offset to reduce overlap
[*]Works with modded pet entries in Data/Pets
[*]i18n-ready text (including Japanese translation)
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]StardewUI (focustense.StardewUI)
[*]GMCM
[/list]
